title: Feature request: read historic BZ measurements of FreeStyle Libre App into xDrip
symptom: Freestyle App does not collect sensor data when mobile device is out of range. Manual NFC read with Freestyle reads actual BZ value and historic data of last 8 hours, but those measurements are not transferred into xDrip.
cause: The patch for the LibreLink app does not contain the ability to send historic data, so xDrip cannot handle it.
evidence_quote: The problem is, that the patch for the librelink app does not contain the ability to send the historic data.
